hints.content:
To measure slope, we pick any two points on the line. Then we look at the horizontal and vertical distances between those points.



[[☃ image 1]]

options.alt: A coordinate plane. The x- and y-axes each scale by one. A graph of a line intersects the points zero, three and three, one. There is a horizontal dotted segment from zero, three to three, three that is labeled three. There is a vertical dotted segment from three, three to three, one that is labeled negative two.

hints.content: The slope of the line is $-\dfrac{2}{3}$.
